basic_details.job_title: Samagra Shiksha Diu Post Graduate Teacher Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for 4 Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts under Samagra Shiksha, Diu will be held on 25 November 2026 at 09:30 A.M. at Government Higher Secondary School Diu. The Directorate of Education, U.T. Administration of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu is engaging one PGT each in History, Geography, Statistics and Business Studies, purely on Short Term Contract (STC) basis for the Academic Year 2026-27, at a fixed remuneration of ₹ 29000/- per month.

rows.details: Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) – History, Geography, Statistics, Business Studies
Post Graduates (at least 50% marks) in the subject with B.Ed. or B.A.Ed./B.Sc.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution, age not exceeding 30 years
EDN/ SS/ DIU/ STC-PGT/ RECRUITMENT/ 2026-27/216, dated 05-11-2026
Purely on Short Term Contract (STC) basis, Academic Year 2026-27

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: All four posts are Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) posts, one per subject, all in English medium and all on the same fixed remuneration. A candidate must meet one of the two qualification routes printed in the notice: Post Graduate from recognized University in respective subject with at least 50% marks and Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.) from National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) recognized institution; or Post Graduate with at least 50% marks from recognized University in respective subject and B.A.Ed. / B.Sc.Ed. from any National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) recognized institution. Medium condition: for medium-specific teachers, the medium of study in SSC should be the same as the medium in which the candidate is applying. The notice adds that this is not applicable for language subjects such as Gujarati, Marathi, Hindi and English. All four posts in this notice are English medium. The age limit is not exceeding 30 years. The upper age limit is relaxable as per Orders/Guidelines issued by the Central Government from time to time. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age; the application form asks for age in years, months and days "as on last date of Application". Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each subject.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The application in the prescribed format (the form on pages 3 and 4 of the notice), with the post and subject ticked and a self-attested recent passport size photograph pasted on it. The signed declaration printed with the form. Self-attested copies of all relevant documents/certificates. Supporting documents named on the form: Leaving Certificate, Caste Certificate, SSC, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation, Professional qualification and Experience Certificate. Original documents, which must be produced for verification at the time of interview. The application form asks for name, father's name, residential address, mobile number, email ID, date of birth, gender, caste category (SC/ST/OBC/Un-reserved), whether the candidate belongs to the Physically Handicapped or another special category, marital status, domicile of DNH/Daman/Diu, medium of study in SSC, education details (SSC, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation, B.Ed. with board/university, year, marks and percentage), experience and any other achievements related to the post.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Selection on 25 November 2026 has two stages: Written Test – conducted for PGTs on the same day, before the interview. Interview – only candidates securing a minimum of 40% marks in the written test are eligible for the interview. Original documents are verified at the time of the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The engagement is purely on a Short Term Contract (STC) basis under Samagra Shiksha, Diu for the Academic Year 2026-27. Selected candidates shall have no claim or right for regular appointment in the Department. The engagement shall automatically stand terminated upon completion of the contract period or as per the directions issued by the Administration from time to time. In the declaration, the candidate accepts that the post is contractual in nature and does not have any right for regularization in future. If any information is found suppressed, false or incorrect, or ineligibility is detected before or after the examination, the candidature or engagement is liable to be cancelled. Contact details printed on the notice: email [email protected] , phone (02875) -252199.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Samagra Shiksha Diu PGT walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, with the time given as 09:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where will the Samagra Shiksha Diu PGT walk-in be held?
faq.answer: The venue is Government Higher Secondary School Diu.

faq.question: Q3. How many PGT vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 04 posts: one each in History, Geography, Statistics and Business Studies, all in English medium.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for Samagra Shiksha Diu PGT?
faq.answer: Post Graduate in the respective subject with at least 50% marks and B.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution, or Post Graduate with at least 50% marks and B.A.Ed. / B.Sc.Ed. from an NCTE recognized institution.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Diu PGT posts?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 30 years, and the upper age limit is relaxable as per Central Government Orders/Guidelines issued from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a PGT under Samagra Shiksha Diu?
faq.answer: The fixed remuneration is ₹ 29000/- per month for each of the four posts.

faq.question: Q7. How will PGTs be selected?
faq.answer: A written test is held on the same day before the interview, and only candidates securing minimum 40% marks in it are eligible for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the application in the prescribed format with a self-attested photograph, self-attested copies of all relevant certificates (Leaving, Caste, SSC, HSC, Graduation, Post Graduation, professional qualification and experience) and the originals for verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Samagra Shiksha Diu PGT job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely on Short Term Contract basis for the Academic Year 2026-27, and selected candidates have no claim or right for regular appointment in the Department.

faq.question: Q10. Does the SSC medium matter for these PGT posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The medium of study in SSC should be the same as the medium in which the candidate applies, and all four posts are English medium.
